items.name: bento-dashboard
items.title: Bento dashboard
items.description: Route page: Bento dashboard preset with Meter, Progress, Avatar, Badge, Card, DataTable and a Timeline; loading (Skeleton), empty and error states you can switch; unit list to detail with a SharedElement transition. Copy the page to app/routes/bento-dashboard.tsx in a react-router app and install the listed items first.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. Import @/components/route-transition before the router is created (root.tsx or the entry file), and render <RouteTransition /> in the parent layout, or the shared-element transition will not run.
